<USER_SUMMARY>
The user is studying async/await and coroutines and is working on a personal project named ORCHID-27. They need to complete a benchmark report by Friday at 16:00. They are debugging async HTTP and encountered an issue related to connection churn, identified as the root cause of ASYNC-FIX-20. Increasing the timeout to 60 seconds was not effective. The user is investigating the connection pool, client lifecycle, and concurrency. A ClientSession with a concurrency of 20 was identified as a solution for connection churn. For the company project BLUEBIRD-42, the backend must use TypeScript with NestJS, not Python.

The user prefers Python for personal demos like ORCHID-27, but for the company project BLUEBIRD-42, the backend must use TypeScript with NestJS. They prefer Python and dislike Java. They prefer short examples when code is explained and timelines when explaining coroutines and Tasks. For async/await and coroutines, the user prefers using a reusable aiohttp ClientSession with a concurrency setting of 20.

When discussing async/await and coroutines, explain using a timeline. The user prefers timelines when explaining coroutines and Tasks.
</USER_SUMMARY>
